file_list.description: List file containing a text list of files to process (up to 400000 files).
file_list.title: File list

paired_diff_norm.description: Compute paired difference normalized by TP1,2 average.
paired_diff_norm.title: Paired difference norm

paired_diff_norm1.description: Compute paired difference normalized by TP1.
paired_diff_norm1.title: Paired difference norm1

paired_diff_norm2.description: Compute paired difference normalized by TP2.
paired_diff_norm2.title: Paired difference norm2

norm_mean.description: Normalize frames by mean of all time points.
norm_mean.title: Normalize mean

norm1.description: Normalize frames by first time point (TP1).
norm1.title: Normalize TP1

matrix.description: Multiply by matrix from ASCII file.
matrix.title: Matrix file

frame_weight.description: Weight each frame by values in ASCII file (one value per frame).
frame_weight.title: Frame weight file

norm_weight.description: Normalize frames to sum to 1 after weighting.
norm_weight.title: Normalized weighting

group_mean.description: Create matrix to average Ng groups, Nper=Ntot/Ng.
group_mean.title: Group mean

keep_datatype.description: Write output in the same datatype as input (default is Float format).
keep_datatype.title: Keep datatype

mean_div_n.description: Compute mean divided by number of frames.
mean_div_n.title: Mean divided by N

std.description: Compute standard deviation of concatenated volumes.
std.title: Standard deviation

max_index.description: Compute index of maximum of concatenated volumes.
max_index.title: Maximum index

max_index_prune.description: Set max index to 0 where all frames are 0.
max_index_prune.title: Max index prune

max_index_add.description: Add value to non-zero max indices.
max_index_add.title: Max index add value

fnorm.description: Normalize time series at each voxel.
fnorm.title: Functional normalization

conjunction.description: Compute voxel-wise conjunction of concatenated volumes.
conjunction.title: Conjunction

vote.description: Most frequent value at each voxel and fraction of occurrences.
vote.title: Voting mechanism

sort.description: Sort each voxel by ascending frame value.
sort.title: Sort voxel values

temporal_ar1.description: Compute temporal AR1 with degree of freedom adjustment.
temporal_ar1.title: Temporal AR1

prune.description: Set voxel value to 0 unless all frames are non-zero.
prune.title: Prune non-zero values

pca.description: Compute and output principal component analysis (PCA).
pca.title: Principal component analysis

pca_mask.description: Mask used to select voxels for PCA (mask > 0.5).
pca_mask.title: PCA mask

zconcat.description: Concatenate in slice direction skipping nskip slices.
zconcat.title: Z concatenation

mask_file.description: Mask file used with vote or sort.
mask_file.title: Mask file

rms.description: Compute root mean square of concatenated volumes.
rms.title: Root mean square
